name: aspr-global-tech
description: ASPR Global Tech website — Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite database

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:separate: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
